content: {"summary":"On 11 December 2025 the SSH session on inventory-db-01 failed to write shell history because /var was 100 % full, caused by unbounded journald logs in /var/log/journal.","likely_cause":"/var filled by journal files because journald.conf lacked a size limit, allowing the journal to consume all root‑disk space.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"/var was completely full on inventory-db-01 at the time of the incident.","evidence_ids":["INC-0109#0"],"quote":"`df -h /var` on the host, 100%."},{"text":"The journal directory dominated /var and journald had no size limit configured, causing the fill.","evidence_ids":["INC-0109#1"],"quote":"journald.conf on this host had no size setting at all."}],"next_checks":["Check other VMs for missing SystemMaxUse or Size settings in journald.conf","Add SystemMaxUse=500M (or appropriate) to all journald configs","Monitor /var usage and set alerts for >90% utilization","Verify that journal vacuuming runs regularly"]}
